**Final model:** XGBoost + Platt calibration (chosen on validation AUROC).
At the threshold fixed on validation it flags 9.9% of test discharges, catching 26.0% of 30-day readmissions with precision 29.3% (2.64x the base rate).

## Calibration choice

Chosen by 2-fold patient-grouped cross-fitting inside the validation set (lower log loss wins):

| Method | Log loss | Brier |
|---|---|---|
| Platt | 0.33000 | 0.09490 |
| Isotonic | 0.33291 | 0.09498 |

Chosen: **Platt**.
